name: Akabira (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Akabira city emblem in yellow: a ring open at the top and bottom beneath a five-pointed star with wings.
history: Municipal flag of Akabira, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 2 December 1966.

features.role: Akabira city emblem — a ring open at the top and bottom beneath a five-pointed star with wings
